name: ten216_recent
sql: select count(*) filter (where observed_at > now() - interval '20 minutes') rows_20m, count(distinct poll_id) filter (where observed_at > now() - interval '20 minutes') polls_20m, max(observed_at) last_row, count(*) total_rows, min(observed_at) first_row from public.ten216_test_odds_changes

name: ten216_books_20m
sql: select bookmaker, count(*) rows_, count(distinct match_key) matches from public.ten216_test_odds_changes where observed_at > now() - interval '20 minutes' group by 1 order by 2 desc

name: rec_bfe_sb_series
sql: select t.book, coalesce(e.tier,'(other)') tier, count(distinct t.event_id) events, count(*) ticks, min(t.book_updated_at) first_at, max(t.book_updated_at) last_at from ten287_rec.ticks t left join ten287_rec.events e using (event_id) group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: superbet_bot
sql: select mode, delivery, count(*) from ten287_bot.alerts where mode='live' group by 1,2

name: cron
sql: select jobname, active from cron.job where jobname like 'ten28%' order by 1
